name: Centrus Energy
thesis: US enricher with the only currently licensed western commercial HALEU production facility (American Centrifuge Plant, Piketon, OH). Not a permanent monopoly: BWXT downblending and future Orano / Urenco / GLE (Silex) capacity compete over time. Sep 2026 catalysts: multi-year HALEU supply agreements with Antares and Radiant (prepayments supporting capacity build-out) and an about $500M Class A common + warrants raise. Educational research only — not investment advice.

Educational research only.
